NPWS alerts read 19 Oct 2026: State Mine Gully Road closed 19-23 Oct 2026 for roadworks; Bungleboori site closed for construction until December 2026 with single-lane traffic on Glowworm Tunnel Road; park fire ban 1 Oct 2026 to 31 Mar 2027. Re-check before release.
